$comment: Hard npm-tarball budgets. Required public docs, editor/CEM data, declarations, runtime, compatibility metadata, and generated references remain shipped. Re-measured on 2026-09-17 after the 18.0.0 batch (lr-filter-bar chip filters, lr-map's interactive legend, lr-virtual-list's light-DOM row projection): 33,766,996 unpacked bytes. Most of the unpacked growth is not the three features themselves -- lr-map now reaches legendTypeShown/legendTypeHidden, so the slice generator moved both keys out of every locale's retrieval slice into its shared slice, and the shared slice ships in every component's declaration and runtime output across all twelve locales. Packed bytes stay inside the existing reviewed ceiling; only the unpacked ceiling moves, and the 140,000-byte drift headroom is unchanged. The approved exception still fails closed above this exact reviewed ceiling.

baselineExceptionReview.reason: The 17.0.0 post-release batch adds a full Romanian (ro) translation catalog -- 13 new source slice files, shipped as 26 packed dist .js+.d.ts files -- plus a small amount of packed growth from lr-select's loading property, lr-combobox's sync property, and lr-streaming-text(-core)'s exportparts. A new locale is a required public artifact under this package's own locale-parity contract, not optional weight to trim. The tree was measured after this batch's own generated-artifact regeneration, and the existing 34,000-byte drift headroom remains unchanged.
